Mow your own lawn and GDP values that work at $0. Hire a crew and it counts.
US GDP was $30.86 trillion in 2025, about $30.9 trillion (BEA, as revised Sept 2026).
Real growth was 2.3% in 2025; before the inflation adjustment, about 5% (our math), so over half of nominal growth was higher prices.
A 2012 BEA study found unpaid household work would have added about 26% to GDP in 2010.
GDP measures the size of an economy, not well-being.
Sources: BEA (via FRED), BEA Survey of Current Business (2012).
News and education, not financial advice.
